blurb: Sunshine Jet Ski Rental offers mobile jet ski rentals where they come to your location in St. Petersburg, FL and take you to any jet ski launch location. Guests can ride on various water bodies including lakes, inter-coastal waterways, rivers, and the Gulf of Mexico. Rentals include single and double jet skis with options for hourly or all-day use.
